Taboo Resume Advice: the rise of ageism — and how to beat it.

If you’re not getting callbacks, it’s probably not because you’re “overqualified.” It’s because your resume is giving away way too much information too early.

In this video, I break down how ageism actually shows up in hiring, why experience becomes a liability before you ever talk to a human, and what recruiters quietly judge behind closed doors.
